welcomeBeforeLaunch.subject: Welcome to TORA, {{firstName}}
welcomeBeforeLaunch.preheader: Your account is ready. Get your profile ready before launch.
welcomeBeforeLaunch.heading: Welcome to TORA, {{firstName}}
welcomeBeforeLaunch.lead: You are one of the first members of TORA. Until launch, the app is open for one thing: getting your profile ready, so on day one you start with a verified page that people can already find.
welcomeBeforeLaunch.step1.title: Complete your profile
welcomeBeforeLaunch.step1.body: Photos, bio, genres, links and your music. It is what promoters, agents and venues see first, so take five minutes over it.
welcomeBeforeLaunch.step2.title: Verify it
welcomeBeforeLaunch.step2.body: Send your code to @tora.verify on Instagram. The verified seal shows that your profile has been verified.
welcomeBeforeLaunch.step3.title: Publish your public page
welcomeBeforeLaunch.step3.body: Once verified, publish torahub.io/@yourname and put it in your Instagram bio. It works now, before launch.
welcomeBeforeLaunch.note: On launch day search, connections, offers, contracts and payment tracking switch on for everyone, and we will email you that morning. Members who arrive with a complete, verified profile are the ones people find first.

_meta: The member cancels; access runs to the end of the period
